newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest bourse seen stable after MOL's pricing.
newsitem.headline: Budapest bourse seen stable after MOL's pricing.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange is expected to stabilise on Wednesday with oil company MOL remaining in focus after its Tuesday evening pricing, traders said.
"I expect the market to stagnate," said Peter Nagy of Postabank Securities. "Now, that MOL's pricing came through, the stock will see huge volume with market focus on it."
The subscription price in MOL's global offering was set at $16.25 or 2,970 forints, with the global offering attracting a six-time oversubscription.
Traders said shares in chemicals company Borsodchem might weaken after its January-March earnings report.
"At first look Borsodchem's earnings report is average," Nagy said.
Traders said the positive tone on foreign bourses should help the Hungarian market.
"I expect the (downward) trend to reverse sooner or later...the Hungarian bourse should follow the positive trend on foreign bourses," said Peter Lencs of MKB Securities.
On Tuesday the BUX index finished at 5,864.43 points, down 38.06.
